<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    plus = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]; cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            plus.append(((min(rows)-12)//6, (min(cols)-11)//6))
    g = [n for n in seg if n['color']=='g']
    ring = None
    if g:
        r0 = min(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        r1 = max(max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        c0 = min(min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        c1 = max(max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        ring = ((r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2)
    return sorted(plus), ring

def center(r,c): return (12+6*r+2, 11+6*c+2)

def do_mouse(row, col, label):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}])
    plus, ring = state()
    print(label, "plus:", plus, "ring:", ring, {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
    return plus, ring

plus, ring = do_mouse(19,42, "jump->(1,5)")
print("expect [(1,5),(2,5),(4,5)]:", plus == [(1,5),(2,5),(4,5)])
if plus == [(1,5),(2,5),(4,5)]:
    plus, ring = do_mouse(*center(1,5), "select(1,5)")
    print("expect ring (31,42):", ring)
    if ring == (31,42):
        plus, ring = do_mouse(31,42, "jump->(3,5)")
        print("expect [(3,5),(4,5)]:", plus == [(3,5),(4,5)])
        if plus == [(3,5),(4,5)]:
            plus, ring = do_mouse(*center(3,5), "select(3,5)")
            print("expect ring (43,42):", ring)
            if ring == (43,42):
                plus, ring = do_mouse(43,42, "jump->(5,5)")
                print("FINAL plus:", plus, {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
